description: Capability for the notification windows (ADR-0054, src-tauri/src/notice.rs), one per monitor, labelled notice-<position>, which the pattern covers. A second window starts with NOTHING granted (see settings.json for what that looked like on the rig). The card's page needs exactly one thing beyond UP-TAKE's own commands: to hear that cards are waiting, which arrives as the notice://ready event and carries no card, so it gets listen and unlisten and nothing else. Rust shows, places and hides the window, where no ACL applies; the page takes its cards with notice_take, reports its height with notice_resize, and says the pointer is over a card with notice_hover, all UP-TAKE's own commands.
